items.title: Steve Buckingham, interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 25, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Oh they sang with everybody. Elvis, Ricky Nelson, everybody.

ctx.x: Oh they sang with everybody. Elvis, Ricky Nelson, everybody. But they developed that thing where they would listen to a tune, a demo, and the lyric sheet would be in it, and over every note they would write 1, 4, 6 minor, which in the key of C you’re talking about C, 4 would be F, 6 minor would be A minor, it’s all relative. Everybody, every studio musician, if they didn’t have perfect pitch they had perfect relative pitch. You give them the root note and hit the next and they’ll tell you if it’s a 3, 4, 5, 6…
How did you divide the work up, because usually you had multiple guitar players on a session?
